## 3. Red flags

### 1. [HIGH] Weekly hours are above what a student may work

The form says 33 hours per week. No student permit allows more than 30 hours, and most students may work 10 to 20 hours. Working above the permitted hours can lead to a fine, a visa problem and trouble for the employer.

> Korean: 근무요일 및 시간 : 월~금 18:00 ~ 23:00, 토 10:00 ~ 18:00 (주 33시간)  (quote matched to scan: yes)

### 2. [HIGH] Hourly wage below the legal minimum

The hourly wage is 9,000 KRW. The legal minimum wage is 10,320 KRW per hour in 2026. Paying less is not allowed, even if you agree to it. Ask for a correction or contact the Ministry of Employment and Labor (call 1350).
